notes: Planning-only partition of the recorded 69 build divergence rows plus one distinct import-only source identity: 70 exact paths, each assigned once. Inventory is a reservation, not proof that a legal patch is available. No implementation, git, br or upstream action is authorized by this artifact.

All seven per-shard read-only legal-route audits are immediately launchable. Later implementation requires authorization plus only the local audit and actual consumed contracts. Do not serialize every shard behind a global ownership freeze or another shard's completed implementation.

Fork-created additions move into genuinely fork-owned modules and lose the old implementations; existing audited identities remain governed across renames. Respect complete-PR <=20 added-plus-removed lines per audited file and same-PR ledger for non-shrinks. Required upstream landings are precise external blockers, never reasons to raise budgets or narrow scope.

Target subtrees are prospective exclusive reservations, not a claim that new modules are needed where an existing fork API already satisfies the requirement. Shared existing app-tools-extensions release-identity, release-envelope and Cloudflare verifier modules require explicit reservation/handoff before changing; no duplicate implementation should be invented.

True coupling: route compilation owns its RSC entry family; CLI loading owns app-tools rslib because loader emission and startup are inseparable; backend config/codegen/emit stays one pipeline; the large Cloudflare fixture/test module stays one writer. Other contracts are interface handoffs and do not impose whole-lane barriers.

Seven workers are justified by distinct artifact owners, not equal file counts. Package-output groups the small declaration/configuration residue; splitting each config further would be artificial. No shared manifests, lockfile, cohort or ledger writes belong to these workers.

Focused evidence is a handoff, not a substitute for the integrator's complete canonical gates and exact source/published downstream acceptance. Preserve Tractor UI; actual ERP/Tractor drivers with shared ports run serially unless supported environments are genuinely isolated. No framework configuration suppressions or upstream-cap workarounds.
